. all saints i know a lot of saints, i do! so let me mention just a few: i know someone who runs a team and teaches kids to play and dream, who stands in cold and wind and rain on days they play and night they train; someone who’s there when we are said, the best and gentlest friend we’ve had, someone who say, ‘just do your best; when i am scared to take a test: a friend who takes the time to show how things are done when i don’t know a teacher who just always knows where that comma always goes; and others who are kind and good, who try to act as jesus would, who show god’s love in all they do i know a lot of saints, don’t you? this poem, by brendan kennelly, gives us an insight into the saints we meet on our daily path .
